page.overview:
Who is Simone Von Konig?

Simone Von Konig was a Mentat in the service of House Harkonnen.

Simone Von Konig was approached by the Prisoner at Riftwatch. She informed them that despite being in the service of House Harkonnen, she despised all of its members and only served them to use their resources to accomplish her own goals. She then gave them the task of determining the cause of the recent deaths in Arrakeen. She told them that they needed to conduct the investigation incognito, as her Mentat counterpart in House Atreides, Andrea Ganan, was already investigating the matter. She instructed to begin by infiltating the labor movement known as the Sandflies, which had suffered a similar outbreak. She advised that they investigate the group's involvement with Captain Tighe Skorda and the crash of the Kytherea.
